issues.description: The script sends POST requests to https://pawchive.st API endpoints to import favorites. All network requests are to the same origin as the page (pawchive.st), and no third-party transmission is present.
issues.recommendation: Ensure the API endpoints are trusted and HTTPS is used. No user data is sent to third-party servers.

issues.description: The script uses localStorage to persist import progress (lists of processed artists and posts). No sensitive data (like cookies or passwords) is accessed or stored.
issues.recommendation: No action needed. Only non-sensitive import state is stored.

issues.description: No use of eval, new Function, setTimeout(string), setInterval(string), or dynamic script injection detected. No @require directives in metadata.
No code obfuscation detected. Code is readable, not minified or obfuscated.
No DOM XSS risk detected. User input (imported JSON) is not inserted into the DOM via innerHTML/outerHTML. UI is created via DOM methods.
No excessive or unused permissions. @grant none is used, which is minimal privilege.
No sensitive browser APIs (geolocation, camera, microphone, clipboard read, notifications, WebRTC) are used.
No @require directives or external libraries are loaded. No supply chain risk detected.
No iframe manipulation or frame protection bypass detected.

summary: The script is well-structured, does not transmit data to third-party servers, and does not collect sensitive user data. All network requests are to the same origin as the page (pawchive.st). No code execution, obfuscation, XSS, or supply chain risks are present. The only minor issue is the use of localStorage for storing import progress, which does not involve sensitive data. Overall, the script is safe for use.
